Äthiopien Restaurant in Innsbruck

** Discover the vibrant flavors of **Äthiopien** right in the heart of **Innsbruck**! At our restaurant, we bring you an authentic taste of **Äthiopien** with a cozy, inviting atmosphere. Indulge in traditional dishes like **Doro Wat** (spicy chicken stew), **Injera** (sourdough flatbread), and **Tibs** (sizzling beef). Pair your meal with a selection of aromatic **Äthiopien** teas or a refreshing **Tella** (honey wine). Whether you're craving a hearty lunch or a special dinner, our menu offers something for every palate. Experience the rich culinary heritage of **Äthiopien** in the beautiful setting of **Tirol**! Come and taste the world—one bite at a time!
